## Label meanings

- **field-tested** — a run journal with harness/tool version, date, OS/user, transcript, gate outcome, and a field-test verdict.
- **conformance-tested** — a green CI fixture/conformance suite names the tested surface.
- **documented** — a recipe or reference exists; no live field run.
- **not-supported** — a stated reason; never an implied absence.
